name: Gaining Acceptance
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.requestItemsText:
You've worked your way up through the Brotherhood's corporate hierarchy, friend. We have begun to look favorably upon you. Quite an accomplishment!

If you're interested in more work and earning more respect amongst us, listen up.

We can refine the fiery flux by adding a simple Dark Iron residue to the mix. The Dark Iron residue can be found in Blackrock Depths.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 50 to 60, 4,700 XP in all.

quests.name: What the Flux?
quests.objectiveText: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole.
